content: Laravel 13.x queues docs (laravel/docs 13.x queues.md, read 2026-10-16): ShouldBeUnique/ShouldBeUniqueUntilProcessing use cache atomic locks (database cache driver supported), #[UniqueFor] attribute + uniqueId(); unique constraints do not apply inside batches. New #[DebounceFor] attribute (mutually exclusive with ShouldBeUnique). Job middleware: RateLimited (RateLimiter::for, releases with delay, increments attempts; releaseAfter/dontRelease), WithoutOverlapping (key, releaseAfter, expireAfter, dontRelease, shared), ThrottlesExceptions (by, backoff, when, deleteWhen). Attributes #[Tries] #[Backoff] #[Timeout] #[MaxExceptions] #[FailOnTimeout]. retry_after must exceed worker --timeout or jobs run twice. after_commit / ->afterCommit() for dispatch inside transactions. Limit::perSecond(maxAttempts, decaySeconds) exists in framework 13.x source. Scheduler withoutOverlapping/onOneServer use cache locks. MassPrunable + model:prune.
